title: Frustrating interface and system bugs
summary: Reviews describe a frustrating ownership experience centered on bugs, buried menu structures, repeated voice commands, and difficulty finding basic controls.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on frustrating bugs, confusing multi-screen menus, unreliable voice commands, getting lost in the interface, and some dealership-related frustration.

mixed.summary: The mixed review criticizes having to learn basic functions through a lengthy manual because many controls are buried in multiple screen menus.

limitations: Several fragments are very short and provide limited detail about the underlying issue.
This topic mixes interface usability problems, software bugs, voice-command frustration, and at least one dealership experience, so the sample is not fully coherent.
